ddl.value: ("provenance" = 'origin' AND "source_message_id" IS NULL) OR ("provenance" <> 'origin' AND "source_message_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: learning_occurrence_presentation_source_shape

ddl.value: ("revision_number" = 1 AND "predecessor_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("revision_number" > 1 AND "predecessor_revision_id" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: course_view_revision_predecessor_shape

ddl.value: ("status" = 'admitted' AND "settlement" IS NULL AND "time_settled" IS NULL AND "settlement_order" IS NULL AND "effect_id" IS NULL) OR ("status" <> 'admitted' AND "settlement" IS NOT NULL AND "time_settled" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_order" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: learning_command_invocation_settlement_shape

ddl.value: ("status" IN ('applied', 'already_applied') AND "effect_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" IN ('admitted', 'error') AND "effect_id" IS NULL)
ddl.name: learning_command_invocation_effect_shape

ddl.value: "time_admitted" >= 0 AND ("time_settled" IS NULL OR "time_settled" >= "time_admitted") AND ("settlement_order" IS NULL OR "settlement_order" >= 0)
ddl.name: learning_command_invocation_time_order
